Population increased in Ealing

The estimated population of Ealing in 2024 was 385,985 usual residents, a rise of 1.8% since 2023.

This meant that Ealing's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Ealing increased by 5.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Ealing was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Ealing

The average (median) age fell to 36.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Ealing has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Ealing is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Ealing's population of 385,985 usual residents was made up of:

  • 72,667 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.8%)
  • 264,673 people aged 16 to 64 years, (68.6%)
  • 48,645 people aged 65 years and over, (12.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Ealing has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (12.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Ealing, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Ealing
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Ealing, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 2,563 people (0.7%). In total, there were 4,584 births and 2,021 deaths in Ealing.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 6,114 (-1.6%). There were 34,184 people entering the area and 40,298 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Ealing's population of 10,342 (2.7%) as a result of 16,458 people entering the area and 6,116 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Ealing was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Ealing in mid-2023 is 379,203.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 4,644 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 781 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 3,863 people.
